title: Charge false advancement and product loss before granting retry amplification
statement: If harmless failures exactly renew the parent, eventual correct step probability is p*v/(p+w+h*alpha). Processing the reader output by any Markov kernel cannot increase joined/unjoined total-variation distinction.

requires: Mutually exclusive per-attempt correct incorporation p, irreversible wrong chemistry w and harmless h=1-p-w; renewed same-state trials after harmless failure without false advancement; eventual usable product probability v on the correct branch; fixed downstream Markov processing.
provides: If harmless failures exactly renew the parent, eventual correct step probability is p*v/(p+w+h*alpha). Processing the reader output by any Markov kernel cannot increase joined/unjoined total-variation distinction.
assumptions: Persistent inaccessibility, changed parent or dependent retry state invalidates the renewal model. No empirical error rate is acquired.
costs: The renewal identity charges wrong chemistry, false advancement and product/reactivation loss. Whole-chain displacement plus local read uses b*L*(L+1)/2+b*L nucleotides; local displacement/read would use 2*b*L if its unacquired operations work. Transport, donor quenching, enzyme survival, product retention, readout release and reset costs are additional. No measured throughput or material advantage.
contract.units: p,w,h,alpha,v and P_step are dimensionless probabilities; b counts bases per block and L counts incorporated blocks. Counts exclude other chemical and transport work.
contract.obstruction: Acquire the same-product serial reader/release/reactivation/reset interface and demonstrate bond discrimination with product/address integrity across repeated cycles. Current state-transition counts and numerical reliability targets are source-reported controls without recovered code, not chemical measurements.

body: Condition on the first attempt: success contributes p*v, while only harmless nonadvancement h*(1-alpha) restarts the identical problem. Solve P=p*v+h*(1-alpha)*P, including the degenerate no-termination case separately. For any output event B, K(x,B) lies in [0,1], so its expectation difference is at most input total variation. No digital/molecular downstream logic can repair an input observation alias without another physical measurement.
